variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier for the Upwind organization.

(Required) The unique fingerprint of a scanned image, computed by Upwind from the image digest and image name. It identifies a scanned image (not an individual scan execution) and cannot be calculated on the client side. Obtain it from the `fingerprint` field of the objects returned by the [search shift-left events](/restapi/v2/search-shift-left-events) endpoint.
